questions.question: If the product of two numbers is 2664 and their LCM is 74, then their HCF is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The product of two numbers is 2664

LCM is 74

**Concept:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculation:**

Let HCF be 'h'

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

⇒ 2664 = 74 × h

⇒ h = 2664/74 = 36

∴ HCF = 36

**Given:**

Akshat is twice as good a typist as Lokesh

Together they finish a piece of work in 7 days

**Formula used:**

Number of days = Total work/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

The ratio of efficiency of Akshat and Lokesh = 2 : 1

Together they finish a piece of work in 7 days

⇒ Total work = 7 × (2 + 1)

⇒ Total work = 21 unit

Now, to find in how many days Lokesh alone can finish the work:

Number of days = Total work/Efficiency

⇒ 21/1 = 21

∴ Lokesh alone can finish the work in 21 days

questions.question: A shopkeeper cheats to the extent of 21% while buying and selling fruits, by using tampered weights. His total gain (in percentage) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Cheat % while buying = 21%

Cheat% % while selling = 21%

Formula used:

Profit = SP – CP 

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

At the time of buying, 

The shopkeeper bought 1210 grams instead of 1000 grams

In other words, He pays for 1000 grams and buys 1210 grams

At the time of selling,

The shopkeeper sells 790 grams instead of 1000 grams

In other words, Buyer pays for 1000 grams but received only 790 grams

In the above scenario, 

The CP of the shopkeeper = 1000 × 790 = 790000

The SP of the shopkeeper = 1210 × 1000 = 1210000

Profit = 1210000 – 790000 = 420000

Profit % = (420000/790000) × 100 = 53.16%

∴ The total gain is 53.16%

Note:- According to Railway 46.1% answer, but this answer is wrong, accepted by RRB. The correct answer is 53.16%.

questions.question: Mr. Ayush borrowed Rs. 3000 at 5% per annum compound interest. The compound interest compounded annually for 2 years is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal, P = 3000

Rate of Interest, R = 5%

Number of years, N = 2

**Formula used:**

Amount, A = P[1 + (R/100)]N

C.I = A - P

**Calculation:**

A = P[1 + (R/100)]N

⇒ A = 3000[1 + (5/100)]²

⇒ A = 3307.5

C.I = A - P

⇒ C.I = 3307.5 - 3000

∴ C.I = Rs. 307.5
